reading.title: The Family Mini Story
reading.text: Today we are at home with the family. We talk about mother, father, sister, and brother. Later, everyone spends time together and uses words like son, daughter, and parents. It is a simple family moment, and we practice the new words together. We also remember earlier words such as hungry and thirsty.
